run_realsense_image_service: run the Intel RealSense image gRPC service on a Boston Dynamics Spot robot with RGB and depth streams
make_realsense_image_service: create a CameraBaseImageServicer with Intel RealSense RGB and depth image sources for a Spot robot
run_service: start a gRPC ImageService runner on a given port using the RealSense camera servicer
add_stream_arguments: add CLI arguments for resolution, image quality, debug info, socket verification, and depth filtering to an argparse parser
review_main_entry: review the main entry point that authenticates a Spot robot, starts the RealSense image service, and registers it with the robot directory
